symptoms.symptom: Connection to home network is not established.

causes.label: WLAN on router is not active.
remedies: Check the wireless network connection of your router.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "WLAN on router is not active."

causes.label: Connection to home network is not available.
remedies: Activate the wireless network connection on your router.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "Connection to home network is not available."

symptoms.symptom: Refill indicator for rinse aid lights up.

causes.label: No rinse aid.
remedies: Add Rinse aid Page 16.
Set the amount of rinse aid to be dispensed.

symptoms.symptom: Refill indicator for rinse aid does not light up.

causes.label: Rinse aid system is switched off.
remedies: Set the amount of rinse aid.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "Rinse aid system is switched off."

symptoms.symptom: All LEDs light up or flash.

causes.label: A software update is possibly installing.
remedies: Wait until the software update has been installed. This process can take approx. 30 minutes.
If the appliance is not ready to use after 30 minutes,
perform a reset.
Press the main switch button for approx. 4 seconds.
Your appliance is resetting.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "A software update is possibly installing."

causes.label: Electronics have detected a fault.
remedies: Press the main switch button for approx. 4 seconds. The appliance is reset and restarted.
If the problem occurs again:
Switch off the appliance.
Unplug the power plug or switch off the circuit breaker in the fuse box.
Wait at least 2 minutes.
Switch on the circuit breaker in the fuse box or plug in the power plug.
Switch on the appliance.
If the problem occurs again:
Contact customer service.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "Electronics have detected a fault."

symptoms.symptom: Water is left in the appliance at the end of the program.

causes.label: Filter system or area under the filters is blocked.
remedies: Clean the Filters Page 30.
Clean the Drain pump Page 40.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "Filter system or area under the filters is blocked."

causes.label: Program has not yet ended.
remedies: Wait until the program ends or terminate the program with Reset.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "Program has not yet ended."

symptoms.symptom: Appliance cannot be switched on or operated.

causes.label: Software update is taking place.
remedies: Wait until the software update has finished.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "Software update is taking place."

causes.label: Appliance functions have failed.
remedies: Pull out the power cord plug or switch off the
breaker.
Wait at least 2 minutes.
Connect the appliance to the power supply.
Switch the appliance on.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "Appliance functions have failed."

causes.label: The breaker has tripped.
remedies: Check the relevant breaker.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "The breaker has tripped."

causes.label: Power cord is not inserted.
remedies: Check whether the power outlet is working.
Check whether the power cord plug is properly in-
serted in the power outlet and on the rear of the appliance.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "Power cord is not inserted."

causes.label: Appliance door is not closed properly.
remedies: Close the appliance door.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "Appliance door is not closed properly."

causes.label: You did not wait until the cycle ended.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "You did not wait until the cycle ended."

causes.label: Door lock has been activated.
remedies: Close the appliance door with greater force.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "Door lock has been activated."
